compiled_state.title: scripts/verifier-corpus-replay.sh: cross-path replay harness (CI + local, ≥95% equivalence check)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/verifier-corpus-replay.sh` — a bash harness that replays each fixture from `tests/fixtures/verifier-corpus/` through both the CI path (via `verifier.py dispatch_verifier()`) and the local path (via `dso:code-reviewer-verifier` sub-agent), compares rulings, and reports cross-path equivalence.

## Done Definitions

- `plugins/dso/scripts/verifier-corpus-replay.sh` exists and is executable
- Reads each fixture directory, loads `diff.patch`, `finding.json`, and `expected_ruling.json`
- Runs CI path: calls `python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.verifier import dispatch_verifier; ..."` with fixture finding
- Runs local path: dispatches `dso:code-reviewer-verifier` as sub-agent with same finding
- For each fixture, compares CI ruling vs. local ruling; records match/mismatch
- Computes cross-path equivalence: `matching_count / total_count * 100`
- Exits 0 if equivalence ≥ 95%; exits 1 with diagnostic report if below threshold
- Required ruling behaviors from fixtures:
  - ee3a-43fc → `drop` on both paths (hallucinated undefined function)
  - b2ef-cd72 → `downgrade-to-minor` on both paths (severity-inflated important)
  - 9e84-2b78 → `drop` on both paths (.coderabbit.yaml false-positive)
- Running `tests/verifier-corpus-replay-test.sh` exits 0 after this task (including functional replay)

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/scripts/verifier-corpus-replay.sh` — NEW, executable

## Testing Mode

GREEN — makes T1 replay tests pass
